stories.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
stories.take: Meta's Muse agent can now take video calls as a customizable animated avatar — the assistant gets a face before the wearable meant to bring it to life arrives.

stories.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
stories.take: Greg Brockman says OpenAI could be IPO-ready in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue — the clearest public timeline yet for a listing.

stories.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
stories.take: Claude's new Personal Finance tool connects bank and card accounts through Plaid and answers spending questions — AI assistants are moving into your budget.

stories.title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
stories.take: U.S. agencies warn of an ongoing cyber threat after mass hacks of industrial, retail and military freezers hit food, transport and healthcare supply chains.

stories.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
stories.take: Meta warns the post-election backlash against data centers could slow AI expansion, as community opposition becomes a real constraint on the buildout.

stories.title: Kalshi court losses pile up as judges refuse to block state gambling laws
stories.take: Kalshi's court losses are piling up as judges refuse to shield prediction markets from state gambling laws — relabeling betting as trading is not working.

stories.title: Software squeezes more data out of Webb Telescope for imaging exoplanets
stories.take: New software squeezes more signal out of the Webb Telescope by modeling the optics to cut noise — a cheaper way to sharpen exoplanet images.

stories.title: Democrats Learned to Win the Social Feed After 2024’s Digital Drubbing
stories.take: After 2024's digital drubbing, Democrats won the social feed this cycle — El-Sayed, Talarico and Mamdani built followings on character as much as policy.

stories.title: American Express Picks Jess Ling as Its Next CMO
stories.take: American Express picks longtime insider Jess Ling as its next CMO, succeeding Elizabeth Rutledge on Nov. 30.

stories.title: McDonald’s Splits Top U.S. Marketing Job As U.S. CMO Alyssa Buetikofer Exits
stories.take: McDonald's splits its top U.S. marketing job between two veterans as CMO Alyssa Buetikofer exits — another short tenure at the top of a mega-brand.

stories.title: How Athletes Are Becoming the Media Companies of Tomorrow
stories.take: Athletes are becoming media companies in their own right — NBA, WNBA, Reebok and Ingenius leaders lay out the new partnership playbook.

stories.title: AI Is Both Canva’s Biggest Bet and Its Biggest Threat
stories.take: AI is both Canva's biggest bet and its biggest threat: rising AI costs, falling valuations and AI-native rivals are converging on the design giant.

stories.title: Sociable: Reddit tests ads in search results
stories.take: Reddit is testing ads inside search results, trying to monetize discovery intent even as its overall search traffic drops.

stories.title: How Victor Wembanyama's improved shot diet is leading him to historic heights
stories.take: The follow-up to Wembanyama's 52-point, 24-rebound night: a cleaner shot diet is what is turning raw dominance into historic efficiency.

stories.title: Should the NBA shorten games to 40 minutes? Pros and cons of move as league battles early season injury crisis
stories.take: With an early-season injury crisis, the league is debating 40-minute games — the pros and cons of shrinking the product to protect the players.

stories.title: LeBron reps tell 'Bron AI' sports betting app not to use 76ers star's likeness
stories.take: LeBron's reps sent a cease-and-desist to the 'Bron AI' betting app over his likeness — the star-vs-AI-lookalike fight reaches sports gambling.

stories.title: Warriors withholding payments to Porzingis on $20M salary, sources say
stories.take: Golden State is withholding payments on Kristaps Porzingis's $20M salary, per sources, as his health issues keep him sidelined.

stories.title: 2027 NBA draft rankings: Debuting the top 100 prospects
stories.take: ESPN debuts its 2027 draft top 100 — an early map of the next class while this season's rookies are still finding their footing.

stories.title: Pujols to interview for Astros' managerial opening, sources say
stories.take: Albert Pujols will interview for the Astros' manager job, per sources — a Hall of Fame bat testing whether he can run a dugout.

stories.title: MLB proposes delaying salary cap until 2028 amid start of free agency, labor uncertainty
stories.take: MLB proposes delaying any salary cap until 2028 as free agency opens under labor uncertainty — a bid to keep the hot stove moving.

stories.title: Guardians' Clase exploited by 'serial liar,' his attorneys say at trial
stories.take: At the pitch-rigging trial, Emmanuel Clase's attorneys paint him as exploited by a 'serial liar' — the defense is shifting blame, not denying the scheme.

stories.title: Varland, Pages, Latz among Super 2s eligible for salary arbitration
stories.take: Louis Varland, Andy Pages and Jacob Latz headline the Super 2 class now eligible for arbitration — an early raise for three breakout arms and bats.

stories.title: Athletics tab Brewers' Castro as new GM amid front office rebuild
stories.take: The Athletics tap Brewers executive Cam Castro as GM amid a front-office rebuild — the move-to-Vegas era gets a new architect.

stories.title: US elections 2026 live: Democrats hold nearly 100 House seats more than Republicans as blue wave continues to grow
stories.take: The blue wave keeps growing: Democrats now hold nearly 100 more House seats than Republicans as late counts keep breaking their way.

stories.title: White House event reveals Ukraine and Russia share one goal: flattering Melania
stories.take: At the White House, Russian and Ukrainian envoys shared one goal — flattering Melania Trump — as she celebrated a single-town ceasefire she helped broker.

stories.title: After sweeping midterm wins, here's what Democrats hope to get done in the majority
stories.take: Democrats ran on lowering costs and stamping out corruption; now a sometimes fractious caucus has to agree on what comes first in the majority.

stories.title: Head of Justice Department office on Civil Rights resigns
stories.take: Harmeet Dhillon is out as head of the DOJ's Civil Rights Division after 18 tumultuous months reshaping the office.

stories.title: US tech shares fall sharply as investors bet on AI slowdown after Democrats’ election triumph
stories.take: U.S. tech shares fell sharply — Nasdaq heading for its worst day in 18 months — as investors bet Democrats' win means an AI slowdown.

stories.title: Six people dead and nine injured after fire at Brooklyn home
stories.take: Six people are dead and nine injured after a fire at a Brooklyn home — one of the city's deadliest residential fires in recent memory.

stories.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
stories.take: Paraguay's president resigned over a bank collapse that froze millions in savings — and lawmakers impeached him minutes later anyway.

stories.title: Newsom moves to commute all California death sentences to life in prison without parole
stories.take: Newsom moves to commute every California death sentence — all 548 — to life without parole, effectively emptying death row by executive action.

stories.title: Nithya Raman defeats Bass to become next L.A. mayor
stories.take: Nithya Raman defeats incumbent Karen Bass to become Los Angeles's next mayor — a democratic socialist takes City Hall.

stories.title: How Mayor-elect Raman will remake L.A. City Hall
stories.take: How Raman will remake L.A. City Hall: the mayor-elect's plans meet a bureaucracy built for the incumbent she just beat.

stories.title: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California to block law protecting children from addiction risk
stories.take: Google, Meta and TikTok are suing California to block its law protecting children from social-media addiction risk — the platforms take the state to court.

stories.title: Amid controversy, California greenlights the state's first large reservoir in decades
stories.take: Amid controversy, California greenlights the Sites Reservoir — the state's first large reservoir in decades, north of Sacramento.

stories.title: State Sen. Scott Wiener to succeed Pelosi in San Francisco House seat, as Chan concedes
stories.take: State Sen. Scott Wiener will succeed Nancy Pelosi in San Francisco's House seat after his rival concedes — a generational handover in the city.

stories.title: Is MAGA dead?
stories.take: The answer: yes, says conservative writer Rod Dreher — 'MAGA is over. It's done.' It brought Trump to power twice but failed to deliver good government, and Tuesday was a complete referendum on him • Vox's Andrew Prokop calls it the biggest congressional landslide in 50 years, with even Mississippi in play • Republicans split on blame: free-market conservatives fault the tariffs and deficits, populists fault a rich-first tax cut, and Vance blamed the Iran war — 'worth losing the Senate for the next six years' • For 2028, Dreher says Vance is now in question and DeSantis — the one national Republican untainted by Trumpism — may be strongest

stories.title: Tech Stocks Plunge as Traders Dump Everything With AI Exposure
stories.take: Traders dumped anything with AI exposure after the midterms: Nasdaq down 4.4% at session lows, Astera Labs off 16%, Qualcomm down ~13% on a weak forecast and surging memory prices • Analyst Matt Bloxham says the data-center buildout will slow — memory is sold out into late 2027 — while hyperscalers may actually benefit as forced restraint eases cash-flow fears • Texas and New Mexico governors-elect have promised data-center moratoriums, likely triggering a permit rush before January • Also: ad-tracker location data from hundreds of millions of phones is being sold to ICE and the Army without warrants

stories.title: What Does Zelda: Ocarina of Time Mean For Switch 2?! - Kinda Funny Games Daily 11.05.26
stories.take: The answer: the hosts call the Ocarina of Time remake Switch 2's perfect holiday system seller — a 96-Metacritic remake not marketed as one, predicted to be the console's No. 2 game ahead of Donkey Kong Bananza, with 8M+ copies in year one and a pizza bet on a 30% attach rate by Nov 2027 • Nintendo held its 16.5M Switch 2 forecast and ruled out further price rises despite profit falling 16% • Sony raised its PlayStation forecast and revealed Wolverine at 2.4M copies in 50 days • GTA 6 is two weeks out, with 39 new screenshots

stories.title: Books are .epubs, .mp3s, and .mp4s, too
stories.take: Reading is not dead — BookTok is the bright spot: literary creator Morgan Book (about 100 books a year) explains how romance and romantasy dominate because they are comforting, predictable and intro-friendly • Books win as an offline object — no notifications — and audiobooks absolutely count as reading, both hosts agree • Her vertical series Drive Me Mad turns book tropes (forced proximity, one bed, secret identity) into short-form video • Closing verdict on the new Kindles: nicest ever, but the base model jumped from ~$60 to $150; the Paperwhite is still the pick

stories.title: Fresh mass protests in France
stories.take: Mass protests across France over living costs and public services: unions expected 800,000 marchers, 70,000 police deployed, tear gas in Lyon as a divided parliament fails to pass a budget • Bomb threats disrupted at least 12 more European flights — all hoaxes so far, but the coordination is raising hybrid-war fears • Russell Brand was convicted of rape and three sexual assaults in London, sentencing Monday • Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football with a record 146 goals in 234 caps, still chasing 1,000 career goals at 985
